record_identity.title: Mandatory online entitlement verification without continuity fallback

summary: A service-continuity and economic-legitimacy failure in which access to lawfully purchased, licensed, installed, downloaded, subscription-entitled, or physically possessed content depends on the continuing availability of a remote identity, licence, storefront, publisher, subscription, or platform-verification service. Ordinary service unavailability then prevents use despite no evidence that the entitlement has expired, been revoked, or become invalid. The July 2026 Xbox outage demonstrated the mechanism across sign-in, game-library access, game launch, store and subscription services, including reports that some disc-based games could not be launched because licence verification failed.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: No networked service can maintain perfect uptime. Treating live remote verification as continuously authoritative without a proportionate cached, offline, grace-period, or degraded pathway converts foreseeable service unavailability into loss of practical access. The failure collapses valid entitlement, inability to verify, account suspension, licence revocation, platform outage, publisher outage, and authentication failure into one user-facing denial. Current CAM doctrine is adjacent but does not expressly require entitlement continuity for purchased or physically possessed content during verification-service outages.
evidence_confidence: corroborated incident and mechanism; precise internal root cause remains undisclosed

contextual_relations.rationale: FM-0007 concerns ambiguity about which account, resource or entitlement state governs access; FM-0050 concerns the stronger architectural failure where valid entitlement becomes unusable because remote verification lacks continuity fallback.

Centralised cross-jurisdiction service dependency is relevant to sovereign assurance, but FM-0050 is specifically about practical denial of valid purchased or possessed content during verification-service unavailability.

failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which a user possesses a facially valid entitlement to digital or physically possessed content, but access is contingent on the real-time availability of a remote identity, licence, subscription, storefront, publisher or platform-verification service. When that service is unavailable, the system denies use without a proportionate continuity mechanism and without evidence that the entitlement itself is expired, suspended, revoked, fraudulent or otherwise invalid.
failure_threshold: The threshold is met where: (1) a valid purchased, licensed, installed, downloaded, subscription-entitled or physically possessed content interest exists; (2) a remote verification or identity dependency becomes unavailable; (3) the user is denied practical access because verification cannot complete; and (4) no proportionate cached entitlement, signed offline credential, grace period, local verification or degraded operating pathway is available. A temporary outage does not meet the threshold where the affected function is inherently online-only and no purchased offline-capable content interest is impaired.

harm_vectors: loss of practical access to purchased content
loss of access to installed or downloaded content
physical-media dependence on remote licence verification
failure_classification.likelihood: foreseeable and recurring wherever live verification is required for otherwise offline-capable content
affected_rights_or_interests: access to purchased or licensed content
failure_classification.failure_scope: vendor-specific incident demonstrating a cross-platform architectural pattern
failure_classification.recurrence_pattern: recurs whenever a central identity or licence-verification service is a mandatory dependency and becomes unavailable
failure_classification.persistence: outage-bounded at incident level but structurally persistent until continuity fallback is implemented
failure_classification.reproducibility: testable by disabling remote entitlement and identity services while attempting to launch valid installed, downloaded, subscription-entitled and disc-based content
failure_classification.visibility: user-visible through sign-in, library, launch, licence-verification and store failures

triage.recommended_next_step: Review Caelestis for entitlement-state separation, protective continuity, cached or signed offline verification, grace periods, degraded operation, outage-state representation, remediation and sovereign-assurance dependency. Route the required corpus assessment through PROP-0023.

cam_internal.governance_layer: entitlement state / utility access / continuity fallback / verification and authentication / degraded operation / remediation
cam_internal.routing_note: The outage restoration does not repair the architectural failure. The record does not require uninterrupted online multiplayer or impossible 100 percent service uptime; it requires proportionate continuity for otherwise valid and offline-capable entitlements.
cam_internal.validator_or_automation_impact: possible future taxonomy and conformance-test additions; no immediate schema change proposed

ecosystem_status.basis: The July 2026 Xbox outage was restored, but the dependence of valid digital and physical-media access on remote verification remains an architectural condition.

repair_status.monitoring_status: active corpus-gap assessment and external recurrence monitoring
repair_status.verification_note: Microsoft restored the incident, but no provider-wide architectural remediation or adopted CAM repair has been verified.
remaining_gaps: Exact internal cause and dependency map for the July 2026 Xbox outage
Availability and scope of cached, offline or grace-period entitlement pathways
Distinction between purchased, subscription, digital-download and physical-disc entitlement states
Provider remediation and consumer remedy for inaccessible valid content
Adopted CAM doctrine for degraded entitlement continuity

review_history.review_scope: Direct web review of the July 2026 Xbox outage, duplicate and threshold analysis, and Caelestis coverage assessment for entitlement continuity and degraded verification.
known_limitations: No Microsoft root-cause analysis or internal dependency telemetry was available.
No claim is made that every game or every physical disc required online verification.
review_history.review_outcome: A distinct failure mode is warranted because foreseeable service unavailability converted otherwise valid content entitlements into practical denial, including some offline-capable and physical-media use.
